page.overview:
Who is Furio?

was a highschooler attending Fourth East High School who was a member of the Devil Hunter Club.

Furio was a lanky teenager with neck-length black hair and freckles scattered across his face.

He was disgusted when seeing Yuko's devil form, calling it "freaky". He was quick to rush to the scene to help Seigi Akoku and the other Devil Hunter Club members, indicating he is loyal and reliable.

When Yuko attacked Fourth East High School, he and several other members of the Devil Hunter Club attacked Yuko. Furio was impaled in the chest by Yuko in the battle, causing his death.
